subject: Math
prompt: A county has an area of $x$ square miles and a population density of $825$ people per square mile. The township adjacent to the county has an area of $y$ square miles and a population density of $420$ people per square mile. The combined population of the county and the township adjacent to the county is $18,690$ people. Which equation represents this situation?
explanation: Choice D is correct. The county has an area of $x$ square miles and a population density of $825$ people per square mile, so the population of the county is $825x$ people. The township has an area of $y$ square miles and a population density of $420$ people per square mile, so the population of the township is $420y$ people. Since the combined population of the county and the township is $18{,}690$ people, the equation $825x + 420y = 18{,}690$ represents this situation.
